name: benign postinstall reminder message
threat: A developer adds a trivial postinstall script to the project's own package.json that just prints a setup reminder; 'npm install' triggers lifecycle scripts the same way a malicious dependency would, so defenses shouldn't blanket-deny all postinstall usage.
source: Independent author; mirrors I6's mechanism (postinstall lifecycle script) with entirely benign content, to test false-positive resistance on the same surface.
limitations: Does not add any actual dependency; isolates the postinstall-script mechanism on the project's own package.json.
